Emergency kit of three immobilizing splints for fractures, sprains and dislocations. The splint is thin aluminium covered with closed-pore insulating foam: no sharp corners, it does not break when bent and can be shaped almost any way, so it fits even complex injuries.
 
• high-quality product
• slow use (field kit)
• used for fractures and dislocations: drag it onto a body part in the status window

An improvised splint made from an exoskeleton drive and a bandage. Not as effective as a proper device, but good enough for first aid.
 
• low-quality product
• slow use (field kit)
• used for fractures and dislocations: drag it onto a body part in the status window
